 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    line = counts.most_common()[1][0]
    base = Counter(v for v in counts for _ in range(counts[v]) if v != line).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Repeated full-width/full-height lines form the lattice. Markers may
    # replace the divider color at a few intersections.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x == line for x in grid[r]) >= w * 0.5]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) >= h * 0.5]
    specials = set(counts) - {line, base}
    rows = [r for r in rows if any(grid[r][c] in specials for c in cols)]
    cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] in specials for r in rows)]

    result = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        outrow = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]]
            v = corners[0]
            outrow.append(v if v in specials and all(x == v for x in corners) else base)
        result.append(outrow)
    return result
"
}
